source.note: known-divergences.md, embedded-data-opaque: a `%%` with nothing after it follows a U+2028 in the alias in the data block and starts no comment; mermaid.js rejects the YAML of the data block, which then holds a line feed inside a quoted string, while this specification keeps the data as written.

error.name: YAMLException
error.message:
a whitespace character is expected after the key-value separator within a block mapping (1:9)

 1 | "alias":"A %%
-------------^
 2 | B"
